name: Komachi Tsugumi
source:
A girl of few words, shrouded in mystery. Why has she come to LeMU?
 
Who, or what, is she? Her cold eyes seem as though they can peer right into the hearts of people and she regularly has harsh words for others. Just when it appears that she might open up, she lets loose with a flood of anger. What is the secret that this strange girl possesses?

[From [url=http://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/931349-ever-17-out-of-infinity/faqs/43865]Walkthrough by Denethor0[/url]]

[spoiler]Her body is eternally 17, but in 2017 she is 23 years old, and in 2034 she is 40 years old. In 2017 she, with [url=/c26]Kuranari Takeshi[/url], conceived the twins [url=/c25]Hokuto[/url] and [url=/c31]Matsunaga Sara[/url].[/spoiler]
